comparison.objective: Wind back a screw-type brake piston and fit two brake pads.
comparison.physical_skill: Press-and-turn engagement of a two-pin piston tool followed by guided pad insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Piston is retracted and both pads are correctly seated with tools and hands clear.
comparison.reason: It shares axial tool seating and rotation, but the turning directly retracts a piston; there is no jam-nut counterlock preserving a calibrated setting or repeated functional-cycle verification.
